title: Wine is a Mocker

questions.question: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler, and whoever is led astray by it is not what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:1 (ESV): "and whoever is led astray by it is not wise."

questions.question: The sluggard does not plow in the autumn; he will seek at harvest and have what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:4 (ESV): "he will seek at harvest and have nothing."

questions.question: Even a child makes himself known by his acts, by whether his conduct is pure and what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:11 (ESV): "by whether his conduct is pure and upright."

questions.question: Love not sleep, lest you come to poverty; open your eyes, and you will have plenty of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:13 (ESV): "open your eyes, and you will have plenty of bread."

questions.question: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp will be put out in utter what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:20 (ESV): "his lamp will be put out in utter darkness."

questions.question: The terror of a king is like the growling of a lion; whoever provokes him to anger forfeits his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:2 (ESV): "whoever provokes him to anger forfeits his life."

questions.question: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:3 (ESV): "but every fool will be quarreling."

questions.question: The hearing ear and the seeing eye, the Lord has made whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:12 (ESV): "the Lord has made them both."

questions.question: Unequal weights and unequal measures are both alike an abomination to whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:10 (ESV): "are both alike an abomination to the Lord."

questions.question: Wait for the Lord, and he will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:22 (ESV): "Wait for the Lord, and he will deliver you."

questions.question: The purpose in a man's heart is like deep water, but a man of understanding will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:5 (ESV): "but a man of understanding will draw it out."

questions.question: Who can say, "I have made my heart pure; I am clean from my..." what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:9 (ESV): "I am clean from my sin"?

questions.question: Bread gained by deceit is sweet to a man, but afterward his mouth will be full of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:17 (ESV): "but afterward his mouth will be full of gravel."

questions.question: The spirit of man is the lamp of the Lord, searching all his innermost what?
The glory of young men is their strength, but the splendor of old men is their what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:29 (ESV): "but the splendor of old men is their gray hair."

key_verse_text: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler, and whoever is led astray by it is not wise.
